name: Bloodmage: Arterial Bind silences enemies and puts a healing pool on allies (#648)
contract: Arterial Bind 681077: "Place a pool of blood on the ground, instantly silencing all enemies for $d and healing allies for ${$681082m1+$681082ppl1+$BH*.33} every $681082t1 sec for $d." DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms, Mechanic 9 = MECHANIC_SILENCE. Effect 0 is aura 27 SPELL_AURA_MOD_SILENCE with TargetA 16 = TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY over radius index 14 = 8 yd, handled by AuraEffect::HandleAuraModSilence (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:92). Effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL on 681082 with TargetA 31 = TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ALLY over the same 8 yd and no target cap; 681082 is aura 8 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_HEAL with Amplitude 1000 and DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms, i.e. four one-second ticks. The spell carries no explicit destination, and Spell::InitExplicitTargets sets it to the caster when a record needs TARGET_FLAG_DEST_LOCATION and none was supplied, so both fixture actors stand inside the pool. Both legs are native today; this is a contract-proof scenario, not a regression discriminator. The tooltip's $BH*.33 bonus-healing coefficient has no backing record (681082's EffectBonusMultiplier is 0 and there is no spell_bonus_data row) and is a separate coefficient question, so it is not asserted.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Room for the healing pool to show
The enemy inside the pool is silenced
The ally inside the pool gets the heal over time
The heal over time ticks every second
Let all four ticks land and both auras expire
The pool is not persistent: the heal over time is gone after 4 sec
